sources.snippet: VenomAI is an autonomous AI agent designed for cybersecurity analysis, threat evaluation, and intelligent automation. Built with Flask and PhiData, VenomAI allows users to interact naturally while performing offensive and defensive security tasks such as subdomain discovery, port scanning, SSL certificate checks, and more.
